purpose: turn each commit into a repeatable, trusted build-and-check result that gates merging
entry_criteria: Repository builds from a clean checkout with documented commands
CI runner and secrets store are available
Required checks are agreed (build, tests, lint, security scans)
procedure: Define the pipeline as code in the repository; pin tool and action versions.
Run build, unit tests, lint and security scans on every pull request, with least-privilege tokens.
Cache dependencies by lockfile hash; never cache secrets.
Publish build artifacts with the commit id and a checksum.
Protect the default branch: required checks must pass before merge.
Measure duration and flake rate; investigate regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline runs on every pull request and on the default branch
Failed runs show the failing step and logs
validation_method: A deliberately failing change is blocked from merging.

validation.expect: latest run on the default branch concluded success for the current head

failure_modes.detection: A failing PR can still be merged
Workflow runs with secrets on fork events

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A new service gets a workflow that builds, tests and scans on each pull request. A test PR with a failing unit test is blocked from merging until fixed.
